calibration_identity_audit.split_ruling: The selected files are train-list-only and exactly file-disjoint from valid825. Train and validation intentionally contain different frames from the same 18 DSEC sequences, so the support is not sequence-disjoint and must not be described that way.
calibration_identity_audit.augmentation_audit: DSECDatasetLite does not apply its transform member in __getitem__; the script also zeros augment probabilities. The frozen config has spike_th=null, and polarity/minmax preprocessing matches evaluation for nonempty inputs.

checkpoint_and_bn_audit.guard_strength: The sealed script requires identical state-key sets and torch.equal for every non-BN-buffer tensor before emitting the checkpoint.
checkpoint_and_bn_audit.independent_tensor_diff_limitation: The imported receipt package does not contain either 225 MB checkpoint, so the reviewer verified the fail-closed code path, bound hashes and receipts but could not independently reload and byte-diff the tensor payloads locally.

strengths: Calibration uses deterministic train-list files only, no exact valid825 filename, no data augmentation, no weight update and strict source/calibrated checkpoint loads.
All 78 BN modules are reset and receive exactly 128 updates; all 234 running buffers change while the sealed guard reports zero non-BN tensor changes.
The 825-frame result is paired in exact file order with both M162 policies and the negative outcome is not hidden by the 460/825 per-frame win count.
limitations: The 128 samples are evenly spaced in the concatenated train file list, not sequence-balanced; long sequences receive up to 15 samples while short sequences receive one.
One batch-1 cumulative pass over 1.74% of the 7345-file population has no sample-count or repeated-pass convergence study.

All BN layers run in training mode simultaneously. Later BN moments are therefore observed under upstream current-batch normalization, not under the final all-running-stat deployment path; a positive result would still require deployment-consistent iterative or training-time fold-aware calibration.
Running-stat eligibility is only algebraic. No exported conv-BN fold, fixed-point quantization or output-equivalence replay is sealed.
The paired no-PAFT five-epoch control has not been evaluated on the identical running-BN valid825 protocol, so M193 cannot attribute any accuracy or sparsity change to PAFT.
methodology_attack.ruling: The method is sufficient to reject this specific bncalib128 candidate. It is not sufficient to prove that every possible BN recalibration scheme fails, nor to prove a PAFT benefit over non-PAFT.

paft_decision.reason: The only foldable candidate is 1.52% worse in AEE than the original running-stat checkpoint and 13.86% worse than the non-foldable sample-stat evaluation. The 0.324% spike reduction does not compensate for the accuracy loss and is not a measured performance gain.
reopen_only_if: A matched non-PAFT continuation control is evaluated on the exact running-BN valid825 population.
Training uses frozen/deployment running statistics or an explicit fold-consistency objective from the start.
Exported folded and quantized software outputs are proven equivalent before hardware accuracy promotion.

p0: Freeze the current PAFT accuracy-promotion line: do not select the M193 calibrated checkpoint and do not use no_running AEE 1.309925 as hardware accuracy.
Do not report AEE, spike count or firing-rate deltas as acceleration. M193 contains no cycle, throughput, energy or physical measurement; AEE is an accuracy metric, never a speedup.
Do not claim PAFT improves accuracy or hardware efficiency until the existing paired non-PAFT control receives the identical foldable running-BN valid825 evaluation.
If PAFT is reopened, require deployment-consistent BN/fold-aware training plus exported folded/quantized equivalence; another ad hoc batch-1 recalibration alone is not admission evidence.
p1: Import the source and calibrated checkpoints, or a tensor-level digest ledger, so an independent reviewer can reproduce the 234-BN/zero-non-BN state diff instead of relying on the guarded remote receipt.
If recalibration is studied again, sweep sample count and repeated/iterative passes, and report convergence under both empirical file-weighted and sequence-balanced sampling.
Describe leakage precisely as zero train/valid file overlap; do not say sequence-disjoint because the same 18 sequence names occur on both sides.
Keep full-precision spike_profile AEE canonical because per-frame CSV fields are decimal-rounded.
Keep the 0.324% spike reduction activity-proxy-only; memory, control, folded-BN arithmetic, cycles and physical power are outside M193.
